title: CaptureRecipe
description: Formal written contract and schema for Greenshot DAG-based capture recipes.

$schema.description: Optional URI referencing this schema for editor autocompletion and validation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the recipe. Matching a built-in ID (e.g. 'recipe_region') overrides that built-in recipe.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the recipe.

description.description: Optional description of what this recipe accomplishes.

enabled.description: Whether this recipe is active and available.

requires.description: Optional list of extension or plugin dependencies required to execute this recipe.

triggers.description: Optional modular triggers attached to this recipe (e.g. Hotkey, ContextMenu, Clipboard).

nodes.description: Flow-local modular execution nodes configured with unique IDs and step parameters.

flow.description: DAG workflow definition configuring entry points, transitions, conditional branches, and join merges.

startNodes.description: Starting node IDs for workflow entry points.

transitions.description: Adjacency mapping from source node ID to target node IDs (array of strings).

conditionalTransitions.description: Branch-specific routing for Conditional nodes, mapping source node ID and branch key to destination node ID.

branch.description: Branch key / pin on the conditional node (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'true', 'false').

id.description: Unique flow-local identifier for this node (referenced by flow transitions).

stepType.description: The modular step type identifier. Supports core built-in steps (Source, InteractiveSelection, Effect, TextEffect, Annotation, SetVariable, ImmediateFeedback, Processors, Destinations, Notification, Conditional) as well as extension/plugin-provided steps (e.g., ExternalCommand, ExecuteCommand, RunCommand, Box, Dropbox, Imgur, Jira, Confluence, Office, Zxing).

name.description: Optional label for this node (defaults to stepType if omitted).

enabled.description: Whether this individual node is enabled in the flow.

SourceType.description: Used by 'Source' step: The kind of raw pixels to capture.

WindowTitle.description: Used by 'Source' step (Window/ActiveWindow): Substring or exact title of a specific window to target.

WindowTitlePattern.description: Used by 'Source' step (Window/ActiveWindow): Regular expression pattern to match window title.

ProcessName.description: Used by 'Source' step (Window/ActiveWindow): Target process name (e.g. 'notepad', 'Greenshot').

MatchCase.description: Whether title or regex pattern matching is case-sensitive.

CaptureMouseCursor.description: Used by 'Source' step: Explicitly pre-defines mouse capture. If omitted, dynamically evaluates CoreConfig.CaptureMousepointer.

DelayMs.description: Used by 'Source' step: Pre-capture delay in milliseconds.

SelectionMode.description: Used by 'InteractiveSelection' step: The UI selection overlay mode.

AllowWindowSnapping.description: Used by 'InteractiveSelection' step: Whether to snap selection rect to windows under the cursor.

Width.description: Border width or resize width (integer or expression string).

Effect.description: Used by 'Effect' step: The effect type to apply.

Annotations.description: Used by 'Annotation' step: List of annotation elements to place on the capture surface.

VariableName.description: Used by 'SetVariable' step: Target variable name stored in context.Properties.

Value.description: Used by 'SetVariable' step: Expression or literal value to assign.

Variables.description: Used by 'SetVariable' step: Key-value dictionary of multiple variables and expressions to assign.

DestinationDesignations.description: Used by 'Destinations' step: Explicit list of destination designations (e.g. ['Clipboard', 'FileNoDialog', 'Editor']).

PlaySound.description: Used by 'ImmediateFeedback' step: Explicitly pre-defines shutter sound.

branches.description: Used by 'Conditional' step: List of decision branches evaluating expressions.

expression.description: Dynamic expression (${...}) or 'else'/'default' evaluated at runtime.

type.description: The type of annotation element. Built-in types include Rectangle, Ellipse, Line, Arrow, Freehand, Text, Speechbubble, StepLabel, Image, Icon, Cursor, Emoji, Svg, Obfuscate, Blur, Pixelize, Highlight, Magnify, Crop. Extension-provided annotations (e.g. QRCode, Barcode) are dynamically registered by installed plugins.

horizontalAnchor.description: Horizontal alignment anchor relative to the capture payload surface.

verticalAnchor.description: Vertical alignment anchor relative to the capture payload surface.

text.description: Text content for Text, Speechbubble, or StepLabel (supports string interpolation like 'User: ${user.username} on ${machine.computername} at ${now:yyyy-MM-dd}').

shadow.description: Whether to render a drop shadow for the element.

filePath.description: File path for Image, Icon, Cursor, or Svg annotations when linked as an external file.

imageData.description: Base64-encoded image or cursor bitmap data for embedded Image or Cursor annotations.

content.description: Raw SVG XML string or text content for embedded Svg annotations.

cursorName.description: Standard Windows cursor preset name for Cursor annotations.

hotspotX.description: Horizontal hotspot coordinate offset in pixels for Cursor annotations.

hotspotY.description: Vertical hotspot coordinate offset in pixels for Cursor annotations.

lockAspectRatio.description: Whether to preserve the width-to-height aspect ratio when resizing or configuring the annotation.

arrowHeads.description: Arrowheads rendering placement for Arrow annotations.

number.description: Counter sequence number for StepLabel annotations.

blurRadius.description: Blur kernel radius in pixels for Blur annotations.

pixelSize.description: Pixel block size in pixels for Pixelize annotations.

magnificationFactor.description: Magnification zoom multiplier (e.g. 2 for 2x zoom) for Magnify annotations.

foreColor.description: Foreground or module color for QRCode or Barcode annotations.

backColor.description: Background quiet-zone color for QRCode or Barcode annotations.

roundedDots.description: Whether QRCode data modules are drawn as rounded dots instead of square blocks.

tailDirection.description: Direction/placement preset of the tail for Speechbubble annotations.

tailOffsetX.description: Horizontal pixel offset for Speechbubble tail.

tailOffsetY.description: Vertical pixel offset for Speechbubble tail.

tailX.description: Absolute X coordinate of the Speechbubble tail target.

tailY.description: Absolute Y coordinate of the Speechbubble tail target.

size.description: Square size dimension (e.g. for icon, emoji, or square element).

margin.description: Outer margin or quiet zone in pixels.

id.description: Unique identifier of the required extension or plugin (e.g. 'Greenshot.Plugin.Zxing').

name.description: Optional human-readable display name of the required extension.

minVersion.description: Optional minimum version required for the extension (e.g. '1.3.0').

url.description: Optional download or documentation URL where the extension can be obtained.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this trigger.

enabled.description: Whether this trigger is currently active.

Hotkey.description: Key combination (e.g. 'Ctrl + Shift + B', 'Alt + PrintScreen'). Required for Hotkey triggers.

MenuItemText.description: Custom label displayed in the systray context menu.

Group.description: Submenu group in the systray context menu.

Order.description: Sort order within the menu group.

OnImageCopied.description: For clipboard trigger: whether to trigger automatically when an image is copied to clipboard.
